description:
Welcome to this brand-new residential development that captures the essence of modern coastal living, featuring contemporary Torremolinos apartments for sale with sea views and a wide range of layouts with 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom options.

Spread across two beautifully designed buildings, these 61 homes boast expansive terraces that invite residents to enjoy the Mediterranean breeze in an idyllic setting, just steps away from the beach and within easy reach of the town centre. Each apartment is designed to make the most of space and natural light, enhancing the sense of openness and tranquillity. The primary and secondary bedrooms are thoughtfully laid out to create spacious and bright retreats for rest and relaxation.

The common areas have been meticulously designed to provide residents with spaces that encourage relaxation, rejuvenation, and connection. Imagine lounging by a stunning pool with a panoramic sea view or strolling through lush gardens that offer a refreshing escape from daily life. Residents also have access to a state-of-the-art gym, a coworking area ideal for productivity, and a unique gastro-lounge for memorable gatherings with friends and family.

Buyers can customise their homes with a selection of high-quality materials and finishes, ensuring each space reflects personal taste and style. In line with a commitment to sustainability, these apartments feature an advanced aerothermal system—an eco-friendly energy solution that efficiently supplies hot water year-round at a reduced cost.

In addition to its exceptional amenities, this development offers unbeatable connectivity, making it ideal for both work and leisure. With direct access to the local train, residents can easily reach Málaga’s vibrant cultural centre in one direction and the charming coastal town of Fuengirola in the other. Málaga Airport is also just a short journey away, offering convenient access to both international and domestic flights.

Situated in the charming town of Torremolinos, this development promises residents an exceptional lifestyle in one of Spain’s most beloved coastal destinations. Known for its stunning beaches, and vibrant community, Torremolinos provides a serene yet lively atmosphere. Here, you can embrace a peaceful lifestyle without sacrificing modern conveniences, enjoying the perfect balance of relaxation and accessibility along the beautiful Andalusian Coast.

Take the first step toward your new lifestyle—call now for information and availability!
